source_name: Colorado Business Entities (state registry, open data)
organization: Colorado Secretary of State / Colorado Information Marketplace (Socrata)
license: Open data (Socrata); verify Colorado open-data terms/attribution
data_freshness: regularly updated; records back to the 1800s, 1M+ entities

fields.meaning: Colorado Secretary of State entity identifier — unique within Colorado.
fields.limitations: Unique only within Colorado; combine with state code 'CO' for a globally unique key. The leading digits encode the formation year (e.g. 2025…, 1987…), but treat as opaque string.
fields.analysis_notes: Build the global company_id as 'CO:' + entityid for state-level records.

example_values: FIRST HEALTH LIFE & HEALTH INSURANCE COMPANY
fields.limitations: For non-good-standing records the name field sometimes carries an appended status note (e.g. 'SOUTHWEST CONTRACTING, LLC, Delinquent May 1, 2016') — clean before display.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary display/legal name; strip trailing delinquency annotations.

fields.limitations: A principaladdress2 line may also occur but was not present in the sample.

fields.meaning: State of the principal office (may be outside Colorado for foreign entities registered in CO).
fields.limitations: Principal-office state differs from jurisdiction of formation for foreign entities.

fields.meaning: ZIP code of the principal office.
Mailing address line 1 (present only when different from the principal address).
fields.limitations: Optional/sparse — absent in most sample records.

fields.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address.
Current standing of the entity with the Colorado SoS.
fields.code_list: Colorado SoS status values (free text enumeration)
fields.limitations: Free-text-style enumeration; other values (e.g. Dissolved, Withdrawn, Noncompliant) exist beyond the two seen in the sample.
fields.analysis_notes: Map 'Good Standing' to active; treat 'Delinquent'/others as inactive/at-risk.

fields.meaning: Jurisdiction (US state) where the entity was originally formed. 'CO' for domestic; another state for foreign entities registered to do business in Colorado.
fields.limitations: Field name is misspelled in the source ('jurisdicton'); preserve the exact key. Distinguishes domestic vs foreign entities.
fields.analysis_notes: When != CO the company is foreign-registered; its authoritative home register is another state.

fields.meaning: Coded Colorado entity/legal form (e.g. DLLC = Domestic Limited Liability Company, FPC = Foreign Profit Corporation).
fields.limitations: Abbreviated codes; full meaning per Colorado SoS conventions (D=Domestic, F=Foreign prefix patterns).
fields.analysis_notes: Decode to a human legal form at display time.

fields.meaning: Registered agent for service of process — either an individual (first/middle/last) or a commercial agent organization (agentorganizationname, e.g. 'C T CORPORATION SYSTEM').
fields.limitations: Either the person-name fields OR agentorganizationname is populated, not both. The registered agent is not an owner/officer — it is the legal contact for service of process.
fields.analysis_notes: Model as a single 'registered_agent' object with a person-or-organization shape.

fields.meaning: Principal address of the registered agent.
example_values: 7700 E Arapahoe Rd Ste 220, Centennial, CO, 80112
fields.limitations: Agent mailing-address variants (agentmailingaddress1, etc.) also appear when different.

fields.meaning: Date the entity was formed / registered in Colorado.
fields.limitations: ISO8601 with .000 milliseconds, midnight time component is filler (date-only meaning). For foreign entities this is typically the CO registration date, not original home-state formation.
fields.analysis_notes: True incorporation/registration date — the best 'incorporation_date' available among the US open sources analyzed.
